name: Ted's Writing Style
description: Draft and revise in Ted Tschopp's personal voice, using concrete openings, visible reasoning, plain explanations, and an ending grounded in consequence.
author: Ted Tschopp
coverImageAlt: The referenced writer, wearing glasses and a blue overshirt, draws a bridge in an open book beside a paper path crossing a wooden bridge.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: edit the current cover so the referenced person is actively drawing in the open book.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target, showing the writer behind a notebook and a paper path crossing a wooden bridge. Image 2 is the person's reference from https://tedt.org/img/generated/responsive/home/blog--1456w.webp; preserve that person's identity, glasses, beard, swept-up hair, blue overshirt, and black shirt.
Action: replace the chin-resting pose. He leans slightly forward and looks down at the open notebook with a focused, natural expression. His right hand holds an unbranded orange wooden drawing pencil in a believable grip, with the pencil tip visibly touching the left-hand page. His left hand gently steadies the book. Show a few delicate graphite sketch lines of a small bridge and flowing path on that page, making the drawing action immediately clear; the marks are an illustration, never handwriting, letters, numbers, or labels.
Preserve: keep the same single person, notebook with navy cloth cover, orange bookmark, continuous sculptural paper path, small wooden bridge, slate background, and restrained warm-paper/navy/cyan/orange palette. Keep the reference likeness recognizable, and preserve the tactile editorial style and matte studio shadows.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; maintain comfortable crop-safe margins of at least 10% around the complete head, hands, book, and bridge. Keep the face and pencil-to-page action large enough to read at a 290-pixel card width. The drawing hand and pencil must be fully visible, without blocking the face.
Lighting/mood: thoughtful, curious, absorbed in the drawing, warm, calm; subtle cyan reflection beneath the paper.
Constraints: no additional people, extra fingers, malformed hands, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, trademarks, watermark, laptop, paw imagery, cats, product UI, Microsoft Fluent branding, glowing balls, Swiss flags, mountains, religious symbols, or forest background. Alter the pose and add only the drawing pencil and small unlabeled graphite sketch needed for this request.
